instructions: What is the relation of the head entity [[H: ...]] to the tail entity [[T: ...]] in this sentence?

P118.name: league
P118.definition: league in which team or player plays or has played in

P137.name: operator
P137.definition: person, profession, or organization that operates the equipment, facility, or service; use country for diplomatic missions

P140.name: religion
P140.definition: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

P159.name: headquarters location
P159.definition: specific location where an organization's headquarters is or has been situated. Inverse property of "occupant" (P466).

P177.name: crosses
P177.definition: obstacle (body of water, road, ...) which this bridge crosses over or this tunnel goes under

P25.name: mother
P25.definition: female parent of the subject. For stepmother, use "stepparent" (P3448)

P26.name: spouse
P26.definition: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "partner" (P451) for non-married companions

P306.name: operating system
P306.definition: operating system (OS) on which a software works or the OS installed on hardware

P3373.name: sibling
P3373.definition: the subject has the object as their sibling (brother, sister, etc.). Use "relative" (P1038) for siblings-in-law (brother-in-law, sister-in-law, etc.) and step-siblings (step-brothers, step-sisters, etc.)

P361.name: part of
P361.definition: object of which the subject is a part (it's not useful to link objects which are themselves parts of other objects already listed as parts of the subject). Inverse property of "has part" (P527, see also "has parts of the class" (P2670)).

P364.name: original language of film or TV show
P364.definition: language in which a film or a performance work was originally created. Deprecated for written works; use P407 ("language of work or name") instead.

P39.name: position held
P39.definition: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

P410.name: military rank
P410.definition: military rank achieved by a person (should usually have a "start time" qualifier), or military rank associated with a position

P412.name: voice type
P412.definition: person's voice type. expected values: soprano, mezzo-soprano, contralto, countertenor, tenor, baritone, bass (and derivatives)

P460.name: said to be the same as
P460.definition: this item is said to be the same as that item, but the statement is disputed

P57.name: director
P57.definition: director(s) of film, TV-series, stageplay, video game or similar

P58.name: screenwriter
P58.definition: person(s) who wrote the script for subject item

P641.name: sport
P641.definition: sport in which the subject participates or belongs to

label_definitions_source: official: Wikidata property label + description as shipped in FewRel data/pid2name.json (verbatim)
source: FewRel 1.0 (Han et al. 2018), official GitHub raw files; HF tasksource copy not used
citation: Han, Zhu, Yu, Wang, Yao, Liu, Sun (2018). FewRel: A Large-Scale Supervised Few-Shot Relation Classification Dataset with State-of-the-Art Evaluation. EMNLP 2018.
date_range: text from English Wikipedia as collected for FewRel (dataset released 2018; repo commit 2022-05-04); no per-item dates
relation_selection: sorted() over the 80 P-id strings, random.Random(3).shuffle, first 20
sampling: random.Random(20261026): sample 2 relations (sorted P-ids) to get 8 items, rest get 7; per relation (sorted P-id order) shuffle eligible instances (file order) and take first n; then shuffle rows; options per row: names sorted alphabetically then shuffled with the same RNG; card lines follow option order

pool.dedupe: a sentence (detokenised, lowercased, whitespace-normalised) occurring >1 time anywhere in train_wiki+val_wiki is dropped (all copies)

state_format: FewRel tokens joined with rule-based spacing (no space before , . : ; ! ? ) ] % 's n't; none after ( [ $ # ; '-' and '/' joined to both neighbours; balanced double quotes attached inward; whitespace-only tokens dropped). Every head mention wrapped as [[H: ...]] and every tail mention as [[T: ...]] using the sentence's own tokens.
uncertain: Track U: FewRel is public since 2018 and widely used in training corpora (and on HF via tasksource), so contamination is likely.
Detokenisation is heuristic: spaced hyphens ('four - level') are joined to 'four-level'; en/em dashes and single quotes keep spaces. Only spacing changes, never tokens.

FewRel labels come from distant supervision against Wikidata and were human-filtered; a few sentences may express the relation only weakly, and some relation pairs are close (e.g. director vs screenwriter, part of vs owned by, operator vs owned by, spouse/sibling/mother).
Some official descriptions reference other Wikidata property ids (e.g. 'Inverse property of "occupant" (P466)'); kept verbatim.
Relations were sorted as P-id strings (plain sorted()), not numerically, before the Random(3) shuffle.
